# FieldGovern

> India's offline-first field data collection and AI-powered analysis platform for NGOs,
> researchers, and government M&E teams. Collect data with zero internet on Android, iOS,
> and web; auto-sync when back online; analyze, cross-tabulate, and write reports with AI —
> at roughly 1/3 the cost of SurveyCTO. DPDP Act 2023 compliant.

Homepage: https://www.fieldgovern.com/

## Product
- [Features](https://www.fieldgovern.com/features.html): Offline PWA, AI cleaning, AI report writing, back-check, skip logic, versioning.
- [Pricing](https://www.fieldgovern.com/pricing.html): Free tier plus paid plans from ₹6,999/month, UPI billing.
- [Use Cases](https://www.fieldgovern.com/use-cases.html): M&E, baseline-endline, impact evaluation, panel studies, CAPI/CATI surveys.
- [Integrations](https://www.fieldgovern.com/integrations.html)
- [Security](https://www.fieldgovern.com/security.html)
- [Demo](https://www.fieldgovern.com/demo.html)
